# ChainSentinel

> Crypto AML / on-chain risk screening API for TRON, BTC and ETH addresses. Checks every address against OFAC SDN sanctions, 900+ curated blacklist labels and live chain heuristics in ~3 seconds. Built for autonomous AI agents: no signup, no credit card, machine-readable errors, on-chain prepaid credits, and a stateless MCP-style tools endpoint.

Read in this order: this file → /api/v1/manifest (machine-readable capabilities, prices, error codes) → /api/openapi.json (formal schemas) → /llms-full.txt (complete docs with examples).

## Quick start (no credentials, works immediately)

```
POST https://chainsentinel.hk/api/v1/check
Content-Type: application/json

{"address":"TNiq9AXBp9EjUqhDhrwrfvAA8U3GUQZH81"}
```

Response fields: `chain`, `level` (red/yellow/green), `score` (0-100, lower = riskier), `reasons[]`, `evidenceLinks[]`, `blacklist?`, `stats?`, `upstreamReachable`, `meta` (requestId, tier, billedUsd, balanceUsd, docs).

Free tier: 30 calls/min per IP, no auth. Invalid input returns `{ok:false,error:{code,message,hint}}` with stable `code` values.

## Endpoints

- [POST /api/v1/check](https://chainsentinel.hk/api/v1/check): screen one address. GET on the same URL returns a usage example.
- [POST /api/v1/topup](https://chainsentinel.hk/api/v1/topup): claim prepaid credits with a TRON USDT (TRC20) txId, returns a `cs_agent_*` Bearer credential. Idempotent per txId.
- [GET /api/v1/balance](https://chainsentinel.hk/api/v1/balance): remaining credits, calls used, estimated remaining calls.
- [GET /api/v1/manifest](https://chainsentinel.hk/api/v1/manifest): full machine-readable service manifest.
- [POST /api/mcp](https://chainsentinel.hk/api/mcp): MCP-style JSON-RPC (`initialize`, `tools/list`, `tools/call`, `ping`). Tools: `check_address`, `get_balance`, `topup_info`.
- [POST /api/check](https://chainsentinel.hk/api/check): legacy endpoint for human subscribers (`cs_live_*` tokens), unchanged.

## Pricing

- `$0.01` per successful paid check. `1 USDT ≈ 1 USD`, so a `$1` top-up ≈ 100 calls.
- Free tier needs no payment. When you hit `402 PAYMENT_REQUIRED` or `429 RATE_LIMITED`, read the `payment` object in the response — it contains the address, network, minimum and exact steps.
- Payment is non-custodial TRON USDT (TRC20) to the operator wallet. No card form, no KYC, no private key held by this service. This is an x402-inspired prepaid flow, not an official x402 facilitator integration.

## Autonomy notes for agents

1. Start with the free tier; no registration step exists and none is needed.
2. Send `X-Request-Id` on paid calls to make billing idempotent — replaying the same id never debits twice.
3. On `PAYMENT_REQUIRED`: call `topup_info` (or GET /api/v1/topup), transfer >= 1 USDT, POST the txId to /api/v1/topup, store the returned credential, then retry with `Authorization: Bearer <credential>`.
4. Every response carries `meta.docs`; every error carries `error.code` and `error.hint`.
5. All responses are `application/json`, CORS `*`, no cookies, no sessions, no redirects.

## Scope & compliance

Read-only risk screening. Supports TRON (T...), BTC (1/3/bc1...) and ETH (0x...) address formats. No trading execution, no custody, no private keys, no sanctions-evasion assistance. Results are risk signals, not legal advice.
